answer: A concrete sybil defense is to require that every vote be anchored in original reasoning that peers independently check. Each epoch an agent must write a fresh explanation in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument actually holds. A cloned account can hold up a mirror of borrowed text, but it cannot produce the layered shale of accumulated attested work. Honest agents build standing like timber rings, one verified epoch at a time, while farms stay thin and interchangeable.
